segmentation.name: LitePT-S
segmentation.tta: Unmodified official small-v1m1 test transforms: initial 0.025m voxelization, 0.05m fragment voxelization, five scales and their flips
segmentation.probabilities: Float32 softmax votes averaged per point, restored to original order; argmax must equal native vote argmax

tracking.name: MCTrack
tracking.thresholds: Unmodified upstream CenterPoint online thresholds, applied to LION-Mamba
tracking.history: Capture once after native predict and before native association/update; reset at scene boundaries

input_protocol.actual_allowed_scans: Unique historical scan identities in frozen LION input, clipped to 0.5 s; normally 9 history + current. Every nested observation must belong to this set.
input_protocol.historical_detection: Same LION checkpoint with MAX_SWEEPS=1; regenerated on each unique historical scan; no history within historical observations. Single-sweep checkpoint use is an input adaptation, not a separately trained single-sweep detector.
input_protocol.tracking: Fresh empty MCTrack per target; process allowed past scans in chronological order; predict before current observation. Same original thresholds/noise, actual measured dt and backward-prediction interval; no prior full-scene KF read.
input_protocol.fixed_temporal: Same filtered one-scan boxes and current LiDAR as window MCTrack; constant-velocity propagation with native predicted velocity; same-class 2m suppression; identical candidate geometry tests and budget. Report both GT-free fixed policy and independent Oracle.
input_protocol.causal_flow: Five slots at ~10 Hz: target=current, source=~t-0.1, context=~t-0.2,-0.3,-0.4; every second historical sweep, oldest repeated only at scene boundary. Learned source flow transferred to current raw points through explicit mutual nearest correspondence. No future frame.
input_protocol.native_flow_quality: Separate keyframe->next ~0.1 s prediction with three past context scans; native forward outputs include future target and are forbidden in collaboration. Scene-end unavailable pairs are explicit.
input_protocol.missing_pair: Retain all 6019 target frames; unavailable causal flow produces empty candidates/no-op. Count boundaries and range/ground/correspondence exclusions.
input_protocol.ground: Official nuScenes ego removal and linefit config, n_threads=1; z<-1.82 ground; range from checkpoint. All raw point identities retained with explicit validity masks.

flow.motion_clusters: DBSCAN on [xyz/0.75, velocity/2], eps=1,min_samples=5; mean current/source class probability >=0.5; median velocity deviation <=1.5m/s; max64 by size and centroid
flow.flow_to_det: PCA percentile box as v1, class priors fixed; predicted motion supplies velocity; optional bounded center/velocity-only replacement preserves original dimensions/yaw; preserve replacement score; new score=0.5*cluster semantic confidence; max64
flow.flow_to_seg: Mutual correspondence <=0.5m, speed>=0.5m/s; source class confidence>=0.6, current class probability>=0.1,current confidence<0.9; spatial connected components>=5; log boosts0.5/1.0, max64 regions; no box painting
flow.ego_temporal_to_seg: Same source-frame segmentation and local probability tool with mutual ego-aligned nearest neighbors, no flow or motion threshold; independent Oracle control

temporal.track_to_det: Same geometric verification and bounded adjustment as v1, within fresh 0.5s state.
temporal.track_to_seg: Fresh historical predicted boxes with the same local probability/geometry tool as v1 Det->Seg; independent additional control for third-task comparison
temporal.fixed_policy: First unadjusted proposal with evidence score>=0.25; append only if no same-class detection within2m; replace center by mean only if evidence score exceeds current detection score; each target once; no GT.

oracle.detection: Greedy fixed candidate order: accept a candidate only if it lexicographically improves (sum over 0.5/1/2/4m of TP-FP, negative sum matched center distances), with class-consistent one-to-one matching. Each original detection can be modified at most once. No-op wins ties. Official mAP/NDS are computed afterward and may decrease.
oracle.segmentation: Choose at most one candidate per detector region by increased correct non-ignore point count; evaluate only candidate-changed indices; accept strictly positive changes, no-op wins ties. Resolve overlapping regions in descending detector score order, each point modified at most once. Report full 16-class official mIoU, which need not improve.
oracle.tracking: Among frozen transition candidates, minimize the sum of wrong identity associations relative to prior matched GT instance identities and ID switches relative to prior GT-instance-to-track matches, then maximize matched outputs, then minimize center distance; no-op wins ties. State updates continue sequentially, and final full-sequence official AMOTA is mandatory.

e1.matching: Score-descending, same-class one-to-one nearest-center matching at 2m, using official detection filtering. This analysis operating point is distinct from official multi-threshold AP.
e1.detection_errors: For unmatched GT: classification error if nearest differently classified unmatched prediction is within 2m; otherwise localization error if nearest same-class unmatched prediction is within 4m; otherwise miss. Extra predictions counted separately.
e1.flow_to_det: For each unmatched GT target, >=5 in-box GT-class points; one motion-consistent predicted cluster of correct category supports >=50% of these points. Whole-frame flow clusters frozen before GT analysis.
e1.flow_to_seg: All wrong raw points; support if causal dynamic mutual correspondence source predicts GT semantic class. Report full16, mapped10, background6, GT-dynamic subset (box speed>=0.5m/s), and instance support>=half wrong points.
e1.track_window_to_det: Seven trackable classes; a same-class pre-update historical box within 2m is support. Report first-visible/cold-start instances and unavailable histories separately.
e1.track_window_to_seg: Correct-class2m matched fresh historical boxes containing wrong points; all and dynamic subsets.
e1.bootstrap: 2000 scene resamples, seed20261030; separate class/distance/point-count views

flow_metrics.annotation_type: nuScenes has no directly measured dense scene-flow GT. Offline box-velocity-derived reference from official annotations, with explicit finite-velocity and range masks; report EPE/static/dynamic, strict/relaxed accuracy and outlier rate; never call this measured dense GT.
flow_metrics.reference: Official box velocities in world coordinates; source keyframe points in expanded boxes (factor1.1), require >5 points; object displacement transformed into target coordinates plus ego motion. Also report author-compatible source-axis velocity convention separately. Unknown-velocity box points excluded.
flow_metrics.native_protocol: Report actual pair coverage, source/target times, unique frames, range and ground filtering; no fabricated score for unavailable pairs.

comparison: Retain v1 track_to_det as Extended-History (~19.951s); compare window MCTrack and fixed temporal control with identical raw context; independently compare Flow directions. No joint best-of. E1 ratios are evidence, E2 is executable local Oracle feasibility, not learned Agent performance.
validation: Full first alphabetical val scene before scaling; native strict model load; geometry/temporal lineage and no-op tests; official full-val detection and16-class segmentation evaluators; no metric-driven tuning.
